title: Replace hand-rolled ==/hashCode on RecentActivityWindow with @freezed or a record

evidence.quote:
bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is RecentActivityWindow &&

why: Standards mandate immutable @freezed classes with generated equality, never hand-written ==/hashCode. RecentActivityWindow hand-writes both. Its sibling family-key type in the very same feature, lifetimeDataProvider's `({int profileId, CurriculumId curriculumId})` record (lifetime_knowledge_providers.dart:148-151), gets structural equality for free and cannot drift out of sync — RecentActivityWindow's hand-rolled version would silently under-compare (stale FutureProvider.family cache hits) if a field were ever added to the class but forgotten in operator==.
recommendation: Convert RecentActivityWindow to @freezed, or to a record matching the lifetimeDataProvider sibling's pattern.
acceptance_criteria: Adding a field to the type cannot silently break FutureProvider.family memoization
